trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order — the campaign first, then the character strands, then the long completion grinds — and use the tracker to watch the per-grade counts close out. It pops as soon as your final remaining trophy lands.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which starts the campaign and introduces the protagonists and the state of Leonida. It opens a new game and cannot be skipped, so simply play through to the mission's end. The trophy pops on completion, before Chapter 1 gets under way.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 after the opening. Story progress is linear, so keep following the campaign markers and nothing optional is required of you. The trophy unlocks as the chapter closes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. As with the first chapter, the campaign is a straight line: follow the story markers, and the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission resolves. No side content is needed for this one.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3, the campaign's midpoint stretch in and around Vice City. Keep pushing the story markers; the trophy is awarded automatically at the chapter break. Any exploring you do along the way still counts toward the stage 3 grinds later.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Play the story through to the chapter's close and the trophy pops on its own. Before going further, consider banking a separate save: the final mission is next.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign's final mission to earn this gold trophy. Because it ends the story, settle any one-time choices you care about before you start it, and keep a separate save file from before the mission as insurance. The trophy pops when the final mission resolves.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the campaign. It is a required story beat, so it cannot be passed over on a normal playthrough; just play it through to the end and the trophy is yours.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, one of the campaign's set-piece missions. Arrive prepared — full health and a stocked weapon wheel make the loud sections far smoother — and play the heist through to its conclusion. The trophy pops on completion, as with every named story mission.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when the campaign offers it. It is part of the linear story, so no preparation or side work is required; finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at its end.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Like the other named campaign missions it sits on the story's critical path, so it arrives on its own as you advance the chapters. Play it to completion and the trophy pops.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It is a required campaign mission, so simply reach it through normal story progress and finish it. The trophy is awarded at the mission's end screen.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A required part of the campaign, it needs no special setup: play through it when it is offered and the trophy unlocks as the mission closes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion tracker to earn this gold trophy. Everything feeds the percentage — story, strands, activities, collectibles and challenges — so treat it as the capstone of stage 3 and work the categories evenly rather than leaving one giant grind for last. Use this tracker's checklist to see which categories still owe you trophies.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the jumps and stunt moves the game registers as you drive. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so it climbs naturally while travelling; if you are short near the end, repeat easy ramp jumps in a fast car until the counter fills. Stunts also feed the 100% tracker, so this silver rarely survives stage 3 unfinished.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once — the list counts nine activity types. As each new activity marker appears on the map, do a single round of it instead of postponing it; one attempt per type is all this trophy asks. If one type is still missing late in the game, sweep the map filters for an activity icon you have never visited.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — the list counts 42 challenges. Learn each weapon category's target pattern, and replay a challenge immediately while its layout is fresh rather than moving on with a silver. Medals are tracked per challenge, so keep a note of which ranges still lack gold and work that shortlist down.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in all. A win means finishing first, so take a practice run to learn each course's line, then race it clean; the drone handles the same everywhere, so early courses teach the later ones. Tick locations off as you win them so none is forgotten at the end.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — distinct events, not the same race twenty times. Any race type counts, so spread across the categories the game offers and take the easier early events first. Keep track of which events you have already won, since repeats do not advance the counter.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take it on when Cal's challenge is offered during his strand in stage 2, and treat the first attempt as practice for the timing the challenge demands. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs the one win.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Pick the shortest cabinet you find, since any single completed game satisfies the trophy and no high score is asked of you. It is a two-minute detour whenever you pass an arcade in stage 3.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand. A strand is a chain: each of Andy's missions unlocks the next, so keep returning to his marker until the chain runs out — the last job is the one that pays this trophy. Strands run alongside the story, so this belongs to stage 2 rather than the post-game.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Work Kenton's missions in order as they appear; the strand's finale is the one this trophy tracks. If you lose the thread of the chain, his next mission marker is the place to pick it back up.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Follow Billy's chain of missions to its last job; only the finale counts for the trophy, so do not stop after the early missions. It sits in stage 2 with the other named characters' strands.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. A strand only counts when its whole chain is finished, so always return to a strand's next marker instead of endlessly starting new ones. The named characters' strands in stage 2 — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest — are the backbone of this silver count.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Play Randy's missions in sequence until the chain ends; the trophy is paid on the finale, not on the earlier jobs. Clearing it also advances the eight-strand count for Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. As with every strand, the finale only appears after the earlier missions are done, so keep working Tyrone's marker whenever you are in his part of the map. The trophy pops at the end of that last mission.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. This is pure map completion: visit each spot once and use the meditate prompt there. Clear them region by region during stage 3 so the travelling is shared with The Goodtime State's exploration.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after, as part of his strand in stage 2. Because the target is a single unique animal, treat the hunt as a set-piece: arrive prepared, track it carefully, and see the hunt through once it begins rather than breaking off midway. Completing the hunt for Bret pops the trophy.
trophies.missableNote: The description names a unique animal — a one-of-one target tied to Bret's request — so this is a single scripted hunt rather than a repeatable activity; take it when Bret offers it.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are picked up one at a time across Leonida, so this is a collection grind: grab every card you come across from the very start of the game, and use the in-game set list to target the sets closest to completion first. Three finished sets — not three cards — is the requirement.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. The counter is location-based, so variety matters more than repetition: do it whenever you arrive somewhere new and it becomes habit long before stage 3 ends. If you are short late, tour the districts you have explored least.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges overlap heavily with normal play — races, stunts, combat and exploration all feed different ones — so check the challenge list periodically and aim at the ones sitting a few actions short of done. Fifty completions is the bar; there is no need to finish every challenge in the game.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build to a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it and escape the heat — both halves in one unbroken sequence. Start the trouble somewhere with an escape route already in mind, then break line of sight and stay out of view until the stars clear. The trophy needs the escape, not just the four stars.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your Wanted Level alive the whole time — letting the stars drop between shops breaks the run. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and never hide long enough for the heat to fade. One unbroken chain of three is the entire requirement.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles as you encounter them across Leonida. Variety is the whole grind: swap cars often instead of living in one favourite, and get into parked models you have not driven whenever you pass something new. The count is cumulative across the entire playthrough, so steady variety beats any single farming session.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up deliberately: trigger Combat Focus only when at least five enemies are within reach, and work from the closest target outward. It also happens naturally in the campaign's biggest shootouts, where enemy density does the setup for you.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, leave VCIA in a way that was never scheduled, such as taking off in an aircraft nobody cleared you to take. The description is all the list publishes, so experiment at VCIA itself in free roam, where a failed attempt costs nothing; the trophy should pop the moment the departure registers.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The name and the joke description both point at the Rhino — the tank. 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' reads as time spent in, or against, one of the army's tanks, and the practical approach is to climb into a Rhino when one appears during high-wanted-level mayhem and stay in the seat. The list publishes nothing more specific, so treat the tank encounter itself as the trigger and make it happen in stage 4.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarm tripped and nobody raising the heat. Case the store first, go in quietly, and keep the stealth approach all the way back out; if you are spotted, that attempt is void, so walk away and try another store rather than forcing it. One clean, unseen robbery is all it takes.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five Bank Vaults and escape from each one. Vaults are the heavyweight robberies on this list, so prepare before every attempt and have the getaway vehicle and route settled before you start. The escape is part of the requirement — a vault you fail to get away from does not count toward the five.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. When one crosses your path in free roam, hit it fast, grab the take, and break away before the response escalates. A single successful truck robbery with a clean getaway completes the trophy.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the map counts 52 areas to uncover. Unvisited ground is the whole grind, so tour each district and island systematically during stage 3, ideally on the same trips as the meditation spots and card hunting. The trophy pops when the last unvisited area is entered.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — nine gangs in all. Every gang must be hit at least once, so keep a note of whose operations you have already robbed; repeating a favourite gang does not advance the count. Spread the robberies across stage 4 and tick each gang off as you clear it.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet one-off rather than a challenge: head to Ocean Beach, take the cocktail where drinks are served, and enjoy the view the description asks for. It can be done whenever you are in the area, so grab it on any stage 4 pass along the beach.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — behind the wheel, through the glass. Take a car inside a showroom, line up on the window frontage, and accelerate straight out. The dramatic exit is the whole requirement; one drive-through does it.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play the bowling at that specific alley. The description names the place, so other alleys do not count; make the trip to Kolt & Associates when you are in its part of the map. A game bowled there with the follow-through the trophy names completes it.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is deliberately vague, and the list publishes no steps for it. Treat it as a partner moment: it belongs with the other partner feats in stage 4, so combine attempts with Hot Together and Retail Therapy, when the two of you are already out making a scene together. If it has not popped by the end of stage 4, keep doing shared free-roam activities with your partner until it does.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This trophy tracks the choices you make through the campaign — for better or worse, as the description puts it. Decisions are one-time story moments, so the count only grows as you play and choose; there is no way to farm choices in free roam. Simply play the campaign and make every decision deliberately, and the tracker fills as the story unfolds.
trophies.missableNote: Built entirely on one-time story choices: each decision locks in the moment it is made and cannot be revisited without replaying the campaign.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on the second attempt — second time's the charm. The cleanest setup is any race or challenge you fail once and then win on the rematch, so let a loss happen and take the retry seriously. If nothing has failed organically by stage 4, take one first attempt casually, then win the deliberate second try.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description asks 'What the hell just happened?' and publishes nothing more. This is the list's oddity trophy: keep an eye out for unexplained events while exploring Leonida's remote corners during stage 3, especially away from the city. The trophy is for being there when the strange moment happens, so explore thoroughly rather than waiting in one place.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: strike a pedestrian with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a lone target on an open road, keep some speed on, and time the swing as you pass so the hit lands cleanly. One solid knockdown completes the trophy.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, so this pairs naturally with the stage 4 robbery trophies: pass every marked haul to your laundering contacts instead of sitting on it. The counter is cumulative laundering earnings, so simply keep the pipeline running until the total crosses a quarter of a million.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Ordinary play covers much of it — vehicles, gear, property and services all count as shop spending — so it usually completes on its own during stage 4. If you are short at the end, the garage properties in Little Boxes are the largest single purchases to close the gap.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight in total. Garages are bought with in-game money, so this belongs late in stage 4, once the robbery and laundering income has built up. Buy them outright as funds allow; the trophy pops on the eighth purchase.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Registration is quick per vehicle, so do it whenever you acquire something new instead of batching the whole job at the end. Ten is a small count, and most players finish it incidentally during stage 4's vehicle churn.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
